content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on data logging using [product_name] and I'm interested in automatically saving data from [product_name] to an Excel file while using a PC system as an HMI. The data log function indicates that data gets stored locally and needs to be manually uploaded from the controller, but I'm looking for a way to have it saved in Excel automatically. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from [product_name] + [product_name] get data with Excel.

Hello, If your PC is on the network, you can utilize the I/O-Status feature. This allows you to store all standard I/O data in a CSV file, as long as the dialog window remains open. In [product_name] go to: Tools/Transfer/I/O-Status. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for an automated way to log data from [product_name] directly into Excel. Current solutions only offer manual PC-based CSV exports while the dialog is active, indicating that existing options don't fully automate the process or provide direct Excel integration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to save data from [product_name] to Excel automatically, ideally in real-time or with minimal manual intervention. A seamless and automated data collection process is desired for better workflow and ease of use.
